content: You will be given an essay and asked about to annotate a specified part from it. Choose the argumentative role of the given sentence from list 1.opp (opponent), 2.pro (proponent). Choose only one label.

Tuition fees should not generally be charged by universities. Universities are for all citizens, independent of their finances. Education and training are fundamental rights which the state, the society must provide. If a university lacks the funds, sponsors must be found. Unfortunately this can lead to disagreeable dependencies in some cases.
What is the argumentative role of "Tuition fees should not generally be charged by universities." from the given essay? choose from 1. opp 2. pro
